scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --parallel --filter @dashora/web --filter @dashora/server run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --filter @dashora/server --filter @dashora/web run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --filter @dashora/shared --filter @dashora/widget-sdk --filter @dashora/ui --filter @dashora/server --filter @dashora/web run test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --filter @dashora/shared --filter @dashora/widget-sdk --filter @dashora/server run test:coverage
